data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 3107, commit 426924a7868 (LLM-Review +1 with no advisories, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Confirmed on main first: scenario_4's final pass line said 'Verified re-runs (<vote>)' for any observed value, including a carried +1, although the scenario only asserts the change kind and the LLM-Review carry; the file header already said it records without asserting. Decision: report, do not assert, because proving a rerun needs a live run against Gerrit and GitHub as an admin and an assertion written blind could pass or fail for the wrong reason. The pass line now says Verified was observed as <vote> right after the push and a rerun is recorded, not asserted; EVIDENCE lines, both assertions and return codes are unchanged; the banner comment says the same. New tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_e2e_scenario4.py sources the real scenarios file with every Gerrit and git helper stubbed: 3 of 6 cases (vote NONE, 0, 1) fail on the old text; evidence lines, a wrong change kind and an uncarried LLM-Review vote are pinned. make verify locally: only the 17 known pandoc failures, no errors, shellcheck gate ran; Linux CI green. NOT verified: the real scenario was never run live by me; making it prove a rerun is task c74a-422f-c35c-492f.
